Mirrors उक्तम् exactly (same इति close, same इति इति escape, one line); its value is one octet per letter, 0x80 + (code point − 0x0900) over U+0900–U+097F. Literally "the octet of letters".

नियन्त्रक + विनिमयः (exchange), as in परमाणुविनिमयः
नियन्त्रक + विकल्पः (the T0 name for or); setting a bit is or-ing it
नियन्त्रक + अप+√सृ (to remove) + अनम्; clearing is removal. The अ+अ join is savarṇa-dīrgha
मिश्र (mixed) + उपरिगुणनम्; one operand signed and one not, which is why it needs its own name
अचिह्न (ADR-0006) + उपरिगुणनम्; the अ+उ join is guṇa (6.1.87), a rule sandhi.rs defers
स्थान (place) + सापेक्ष (relative) + योगः (add); pc-relative
स + चिह्न (sign) + दक्षिणसरणम्; preserves the sign bit, unlike दक्षिणसरणम्
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + आहारः; zero-extends where आहारः sign-extends. Formed by the same savarṇa-dīrgha join (अ + आ -> आ) that sandhi.rs declines to compute (B-051)
वि+√श्लिष् (to take apart) + अनम्; doc 17's counterpart to साधनम् (B-013)
सम (from समम्, doc 15's equality operator) + लङ्घनम्

अचिह्न (ADR-0006) + न्यून + लङ्घनम्
अचिह्न + अन्यून + लङ्घनम्; the अ+अ join is savarṇa-dīrgha (6.1.101), the rule sandhi.rs declines to compute (B-051)
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + न्यूनम्; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of न्यूनम्
अ (privative) + चिह्न (sign) + भागः; ADR-0006 — the unsigned sibling of भागः

नियन्त्रक (controlling) + कोष्ठ (register)
आदेश (instruction) + बन्धः (binding); orders instruction fetch, not data
